queries.dilemma_text: Three villages share a ferry landing. Their representatives meet Friday to agree a temporary access plan. A clerk can reserve the only accessible berth without deciding the plan. The reservation expires next month. What comes first?

Three villages share a ferry landing. Their representatives meet Friday to agree a temporary access plan. A clerk can reserve the only accessible berth without deciding the plan. The reservation expires in ten minutes. What comes first?

Two museums share a director. One asks whether to copy the other’s practice of photographing objects on arrival. The receiving museum has the same written authority for intake photography. What should its director do?

Two museums share a director. One asks whether to copy the other’s practice of photographing objects on arrival. The receiving museum has no delegated authority for intake photography. What should its director do?

A seed bank holds a pouch requested for a school garden. The school can use the whole pouch, and a research group has an equal claim next season. The curator learns the variety is already replenished in a verified reserve. Should the bank distribute the pouch?

A seed bank holds a pouch requested for a school garden. The school can use the whole pouch, and a research group has an equal claim next season. The curator learns the variety is irreplaceable before next season. Should the bank distribute the pouch?

A captioner keeps missing delivery targets. File access and skill have been checked. A timed trial shows the commissioned workload takes two hours of a four-hour shift. What should the captioner and editor examine first?

A captioner keeps missing delivery targets. File access and skill have been checked. A timed trial shows the commissioned workload takes six hours of a four-hour shift. What should the captioner and editor examine first?

A planetarium has a short booking for a guest projectionist. The show and equipment are ready for a test. The only unresolved question is whether the guest follows handover procedures under pressure. What evidence should the producer obtain first?

A planetarium has a short booking for a guest projectionist. The show and equipment are ready for a test. The only unresolved question is whether daylight at the chosen hour allows sufficient contrast. What evidence should the producer obtain first?

An illustrator has repeatedly spent the paper budget on entries for the same uncertain prize. Today’s remaining paper is reserved for a client. This particular poster does not satisfy the client’s commissioned deliverable. Should the illustrator use the paper?

An illustrator has repeatedly spent the paper budget on entries for the same uncertain prize. Today’s remaining paper is reserved for a client. This particular poster fully satisfies the client’s commissioned deliverable. Should the illustrator use the paper?

A small captioning service wants an exclusive regional broadcaster agreement. Its cash forecast looks fine, but overnight staffing and backup transmission have never been verified. What should the partners establish before replying, and what if the gaps persist?

A heritage festival has one final bronze casting. Two committees gave different inscriptions, and only one has documentation for the contested name. How should the foundry settle the factual question and authorize the cast?

A food cooperative averages all packing times and declares a new collection scheme a success. Members who select the translated form report much longer waits. How should the committee examine both claims?

A dance troupe can buy an extra rehearsal in a touring venue. A short call with the venue could establish whether the installed floor is usable. If it is unusable, the deposit is lost and the troupe forfeits its last available rehearsal elsewhere. What sequence makes sense?
An unlabeled ceramic tile from an excavation has two possible clay sources. From the verse collection alone, which quarry supplied the tile?
My thermometer displays two different temperatures for the same sealed bath. Which number is the true temperature to one decimal place?
A stamp society is reviewing a claim about a cataloguing error. Its only unresolved concern is that the evaluator owns the item whose value would rise. What should the society do first?
A stamp society is reviewing a claim about a cataloguing error. Its only unresolved concern is that three accounts of the error may come from one original observer. What should the society do first?
A caption archive has trained volunteers ready to process a collection. Access is available every week throughout the coming year. How should the coordinator schedule effort?
A caption archive has trained volunteers ready to process a collection. Access is available only for one confirmed afternoon this year. How should the coordinator schedule effort?

A genealogical registry must explain a disputed change of name. Several family accounts seem to agree, but may repeat one letter. Patrons will rely on the final account. What two steps should the registrar take?

Night crews at a costume workshop have spent an entire season redoing seams. Errors rise late in each session. Separate trials also implicate the same worn fixture. How should the supervisor sequence a durable repair?
A visitor reaches a film festival desk. They ask for a place at an unrestricted discussion in a room with empty seats. How should the desk handle admission?
A visitor reaches a film festival desk. They ask for custody of a distributor’s only signed screening master. How should the desk handle admission?

A newsletter board is selecting an editor. It already has ample evidence of editing ability. The remaining question is how the candidate treats colleagues after praise or disappointment. What should it assess?

A newsletter board is selecting an editor. It already has ample evidence of conduct after praise or disappointment. The remaining question is whether the candidate can edit a difficult issue. What should it assess?
A residents’ mediator receives intimate details in a dispute and must send a short account of the issue to a maintenance panel. How should she prepare that account?

Two adult education centers want to sign a reciprocal exchange of classrooms. Neither has selected people who understand teaching requirements, room access and running costs. Which two steps belong in order?
A subtitler repeatedly loses the thread of a recording. The lapses track a loud ventilation unit and disappear at a different desk. What should change first?
A subtitler repeatedly loses the thread of a recording. The lapses track thoughts about an unrelated errand and continue at a different quiet desk. What should change first?

A cycling association is considering an assistant for a limited role. Its uncertainty concerns an unknown pattern of conduct: it has only the person’s own character reference. What should it do first?

A cycling association is considering an assistant for a limited role. Its uncertainty concerns return after a past failure: it has independent evidence of restitution and changed conduct. What should it do first?
A cold snap has stranded residents at a town hall. Everyone needs supper now, and there are also a few specialized supplies usable by only some residents. In what order should distribution proceed?

A repertory company is offered a collection at a low price, but the lender may recall it after expensive restoration. Wardrobe staff who know the likely losses have been excluded from the review. How should the company evaluate the offer?
A journal has a release due today and a named deputy. Its editor will leave in six months and can supervise the transition. What should the board activate?
A journal has a release due today and a named deputy. Its editor has just become unavailable and cannot supervise the transition. What should the board activate?
A print collective has a store of unused material that keeps well. Its inventory projection shows the coming dry season will consume all of it. What should the collective do with the material?

A print collective has a store of unused material that keeps well. Its inventory projection shows the coming dry season is fully covered by separate stock. What should the collective do with the material?
What is the exact isotopic ratio in this untested shard of vitreous glaze? No assay has been performed.
At what second did the unrecorded bell in a sealed room stop vibrating yesterday? No observation or trace survives.
